during-while-guthix-sleeps-before-planti.npc: Good day to you. I've prepared this patch for you to plant the enriched snapdragon in.

during-while-guthix-sleeps-after-plantin.npc: Good day to you. The enriched snapdragon is growing well. It should be ready soon.

during-while-guthix-sleeps-after-recruit.npc: Good day to you. The enriched snapdragon is fully grown and ready for you to harvest.

during-while-guthix-sleeps-after-picking.npc: Good day to you. You should take that enriched snapdragon to Thaerisk.

during-while-guthix-sleeps-after-losing-.player: I lost the enriched snapdragon I harvested.

during-while-guthix-sleeps-after-losing-.npc: Not to worry. There was some left over after you were done.

during-while-guthix-sleeps-after-losing-.text: The druid gives you some enriched snapdragon.
